notes: New independently generated assets. Originals copied byte-for-byte, no image postprocessing. Model returned 2172x724 despite prompt requesting 3072x1024. Normalized anchors use full image UV coordinates.

assets.full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready distant environment panorama background for LETZTE SCHICHT, a serious 2D industrial bunker-defense pixel-art game.
Output: ONE single continuous ultra-wide 3:1 image, requested native size 3072x1024 PNG, no border, no panels, no words.
Style: cohesive premium detailed hand-crafted industrial pixel art, deliberate crisp squared pixel clusters and sharp stair-step contours, restrained material texture, no random mottled noise, no watercolor or painterly brush marks, no photorealism, no glossy 3D. Pixel cluster size should read like an expertly crafted 1536x512 pixel canvas nearest-neighbor enlarged. Architectural shapes must be structurally coherent and recognizable. Layered atmospheric silhouettes separated by value with clean open negative spaces.
Composition: distant horizontal side view across a broad landscape; sky approximately the upper 30 percent; unique hero landmarks occupy y=25%-65%, including substantial recognizable landmarks in the RIGHT HALF because a gameplay bunker will cover the left half. The lowest 30% is calm low-contrast dark distant terrain or water, without large near-camera props. Prioritize immediately readable silhouette and value hierarchy at thumbnail size. No foreground platforms, no underground cutaway, no bunker, no rooms, no people, no robots, no game UI, no logos or text. Static architecture intact. No baked-in snow, rain, sparks, floating embers, smoke plumes or particles; those will be animated by the game. Broad restrained clouds allowed; avoid intricate stippled clouds covering the whole frame.
World: ASH FOUNDRY. A monumental working smelting foundry at deep charcoal-blue night, viewed from far across a plain. One giant recognizable blast furnace in the right-center at x=.66 with tall pipework, rust-copper gantries and a towering flared cooling tower around x=.83. A secondary asymmetric furnace structure at x=.22 balances the vista. Thick sparse straight chimneys with visible emission outlets; tiny amber industrial windows and intense local orange light spilling from a few furnace doors, not an orange sky. Heavy charcoal masses, dark oxidized copper accents, ash-gray distance and furnace-orange LOCAL glows. Dark blue slate sky with broad calm cloud masses, no sunset stripe. Lower third nearly black quiet slag fields fading into distant atmospheric layers, clean modest geometry. The furnace and cooling tower must read as the unique monumental subject, not a generic repetitive factory skyline. Restrained cinematic lighting, serious quiet sense of vast scale.
assets.inspection: Recognizable right-side blast furnace and cooling tower; chimney outlets have no baked smoke. Furnace light is local. Calm lower terrain.
